consequences: CEO/PMO and Agent HR are built-in runtime-neutral modules
AI-PMO owns concrete role, Skill, Prompt and evaluation content through versioned references
Project tasks remain owned by each project repository
context: The historical alpha exposed the Project Kernel but did not encode the local Founder/CEO/PMO/HR operating model.
decision: Model Agent Project OS as one package with Project Kernel, Governance, Workforce, Cadence and Adapter layers.
rationale: The product must reduce the cognitive load of managing dozens of local AI-native projects and their Agent workforce, not only track cross-project evidence.
title: Make organization governance part of the core product
